title: Cerebras Systems
summary: Sunnyvale company building wafer-scale AI processors and an inference cloud.
bodyHtml:
Cerebras makes the Wafer Scale Engine, a single wafer-sized chip designed to keep model weights on-chip and avoid the memory bottlenecks of GPU clusters.

It sells systems to labs and enterprises and runs its own inference service, which has made it a visible alternative for very fast token generation.

Why it matters

  • Wafer-scale engine
  • Inference-as-a-service
  • Large-model training systems

businessMeaning: Wafer-scale is a different point in the design space: enormous on-chip memory and bandwidth at the cost of yield and packaging complexity. Its cloud business tests whether customers pay for latency.
investmentLens: Private; the public read is advanced packaging and substrate demand, plus the cloud competitors it pressures.
